quick_skim.title: Multilayer Q-Matrix-Embedded Neural Network for Cognitive Diagnosis (M-QCDNet): Structure-Aware Deep Learning Architecture for Psychometric Interpretability
quick_skim.abstract: The research proposes a multilayer Q-matrix-embedded neural network for cognitive diagnosis (M-QCDNet), which integrates the structural interpretability of cognitive diagnostic models (CDMs) with the deep learning neural network (NN). M-QCDNet structures the item-skill relationship using the Q-matrix as a structural prior, ensuring latent mastery profiles remain interpretable and consistent with cognitive theory, followed by the proposed loss function with an L2 penalty to penalize skills not aligned with the Q-matrix and to balance predictive performance and structural alignment. Corresponding evaluation matrices, the interpretable alignment-based metrics that quantify the degree to which predicted skill activations correspond to item-level skills, were further developed. M-QCDNet offers practical benefits for classroom practice, enabling early detection of learning difficulties and supporting mastery-based interventions. By embedding diagnostic validity into model design, M-QCDNet bridges psychometric transparency and neural flexibility, advancing interpretable, fair, and actionable AI for cognitive diagnostics.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper proposes M-QCDNet, a neural network integrating a Q-matrix for cognitive diagnosis, ensuring interpretable student skill profiles for assessment.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文提出M-QCDNet，一种结合Q矩阵的深层神经网络用于认知诊断，通过结构先验确保诊断结果可解释。该方法将Q矩阵作为结构先验嵌入神经网络，以实现技能-题目关系建模，并设计带L2惩罚的损失函数来对齐技能维度。实验表明，该架构在保持心理测量学可解释性的同时，有效提升了诊断准确性，为教育测量中认知建模提供了一种可扩展的深度学习方法。
